programme.title: Jules
programme.desc: Milton är en småstadspensionär som lever ett lugnt liv.. När ett rymdskepp kraschar i hans trädgård och strandsätter sin utomjordiska pilot – med smeknamnet "Jules" – inleder de en ovanlig vänskap.. Tillsammans med sina grannar försöker han hålla Jules existens hemlig.

programme.title: Supercell
programme.desc: När William Brody var barn blev hans pappa, en legendarisk stormjägare, dödad av en supercellstornado.. Nu tillhör familjeföretaget Zane Roger, en girig och hänsynslös researrangör.. När Williams öde visar sig i form av en av de mest kraftfulla stormarna någonsin, lämnar han sitt hem för att slå sig ihop med sin fars ex-partner, Roy Cameron, fast besluten att jaga en av naturens mest skrämmande skapelser.

programme.title: Ghostbusters: Frozen Empire
programme.desc: Familjen Spengler återvänder till platsen där allt började – den ikoniska brandstationen i New York City.. Det ursprungliga Ghostbusters-gänget har satt upp ett topphemligt forskningslabb som tar infångandet av spöken till en ny nivå.. Men när upptäckten av en uråldrig artefakt frigör en ond kraft måste nya och gamla Ghostbusters samarbeta för att skydda deras hem och rädda världen från en ny istid.

programme.title: Fjärilen Patrik på äventyr
programme.desc: Patrik är en modig och påhittig fjäril som inte kan flyga - men det håller honom inte tillbaka!. Patrik drömmer om att följa med den stora migrationen och gömmer sig i en växtvagn för att förverkliga drömmen.. Tillsammans med sina vänner, den roliga larven Martin och fjärilen Jennifer som är höjdrädd, ger de sig ut på ett spännande äventyr. Patrik kommer att bli en osannolik hjälte, men först måste han möta sina rädslor, omfamna sin unikhet och triumfera över motgångar när han kämpar mot det växlande vädret, människor och tre onda fåglar som vill hämnas. Men tillsammans klarar de allt!

programme.title: Summer camp
programme.desc: Ginny, Nora och Mary har varit bästa vänner sedan barnsben, de tillbringade somrarna oskiljaktiga på sommarläger.. 50 år senare är deras liv kanske inte vad de hade tänkt sig, men en sak är säker; Ginny, Nora och Mary behöver varandra, och en sommarläger-återförening påminner dem om varför.

programme.title: Origin
programme.desc: Sargad av sorg och kärlek färdas hon över kontinenter och genom främmande kulturer i arbetet med sin bästsäljande ”Caste”.. Isabel Wilkersons (Aunjanue Ellis-Taylor) episka resa, såväl yttre som inre, är en berättelse om historians mysterier, romantikens under och kampen för en bättre framtid.

programme.title: Wildcat
programme.desc: Det är 50-tal i Georgia när 24-åriga Flannery O’Connor diagnosticeras med lupus.. Nu ska hon plågas av samma sjukdom som tog hennes far ifrån henne som barn.. Men sjukdomen blir till hennes drivkraft, nu är Flannery mer fast besluten än någonsin att hon ska lämna avtryck i historien som författare.

programme.title: Kidnapping inc
programme.desc: Doc och Zoe anlitas för vad som av allt att döma tycks vara ett helt vanligt, ganska enkelt kidnappningsjobb. Det är nämligen sånt de gör.. De ska transportera en presidentkandidats son från en plats till en annan, men inget går enligt plan och plötsligt är det olyckliga radarparet huvudpersoner i en politisk konspiration.

programme.title: Out come the wolves
programme.desc: Ashley bjuder sin bästa vän Kyle till hennes familjs avskilda stuga i skogen för att han ska få träffa hennes fästmö, Nolan.. Stämningen mellan de nyförlovade blir snart spänd när Nolan börjar ifrågasätta Ashleys vänskap med Kyle.. Gruppen tar sig ut i skogen för att jaga rådjur, men när en flock utsvultna vargar börjar förfölja dem måste de använda sig av alla sina färdigheter för att kämpa för sin överlevnad och bemöta naturens mörkaste sidor.

programme.title: Night call
programme.desc: Om dagarna är Mady en helt vanlig student, på kvällarna jobbar han extra som låssmed.. En mystisk ung kvinna ger honom ett uppdrag och när han väl fått upp låset dröjer det inte länge innan han börjar ana oråd. Det är början på den mest intensiva natten i Madys liv.. Night Call är en fartfylld actionthriller om en oskyldig man på jakt efter bevis att rentvå sig med.

programme.title: Die alone
programme.desc: Efter en bilolycka vaknar Ethan upp till en värld som vänts upp och ner av en ny pest som förvandlar de infekterade till zombies.

programme.title: Fjärilen Patrik på äventyr
programme.desc: Patrik är en modig och påhittig fjäril som inte kan flyga - men det håller honom inte tillbaka!. programme.title: The vows we keep
programme.desc: En evenemangsplanerare finner kärlek och ett nytt syfte när hon arbetar med ett historiskt värdshus sista bröllop.

programme.title: Tatami
programme.desc: Den iranska kvinnliga judomästaren Leila och hennes tränare Maryam, reser till Judo-VM, med avsikt att ta hem Irans första guldmedalj.. Halvvägs genom Judo-VM får de ett ultimatum från Islamiska republiken som beordrar Leila att fejka en skada och förlora, annars kommer hon att bli stämplad som en statsförrädare.. Med sin egen och sin familjs frihet på spel står Leila inför ett omöjligt val: följa den iranska regimen som hennes tränare Maryam ber henne att göra, eller kämpa vidare, för guldet.

programme.title: Winner
programme.desc: Reality Winner bestämmer sig tidigt för att hon ska tjänstgöra i militären.. Hon lär sig arabiska på fritiden för att, när tiden är kommen, vara så redo som möjligt.. Efter en prisad sejour i flygvapnet börjar hon ifrågasätta sina livsval, och när hon kommer över komprometterande regeringshemligheter är hon inte långt borta från den visselblåsare hennes namn kommit att förknippas med.

programme.title: Monster summer
programme.desc: Sommaren 1997. Noah och hans vänner ser fram emot sitt livs bästa lov – tills en mystisk kraft slår till.. Barn börjar försvinna och återvänder med tomma, stirrande blickar.. För att lösa gåtan slår sig gänget samman med en pensionerad polis och inser snart att sommaren döljer något långt mer skrämmande än de kunnat föreställa sig.

programme.title: The last showgirl
programme.desc: Shelly är en glamorös showgirl från Las Vegas som måste planera för framtiden när hennes show plötsligt läggs ner efter 30 år.

programme.title: Vitt skräp
programme.desc: Sami hamnar i ett litet samhälle där han träffar Kim. De båda möter den lokale gangstern Gubben som driver drogaffärer tillsammans med sina två söner.. Till en början är allt frid och fröjd men när droger börjar cirkulera på bygden utan Gubbens tillåtelse riktas uppmärksamheten mot nykomlingen Sami som inser att han är i fara.

programme.title: Kidnapping inc

Med sin egen och sin familjs frihet på spel står Leila inför ett omöjligt val: följa den iranska regimen som hennes tränare Maryam ber henne att göra, eller kämpa vidare, för guldet.

programme.title: Ordinary angels

programme.title: Bridget Jones: Mad About the Boy

programme.title: Bridget Jones's Diary
programme.desc: A single woman begins a new year with resolutions to find love, quit her bad habits and take a step up the career ladder. Her plans crumble as she tries to deal with her mother's infidelity, get over a passionate fling with her boss and come to terms with her feelings for an uptight lawyer. Romantic comedy based on Helen Fielding's novel, starring Renee Zellweger, Hugh Grant and Colin Firth.

programme.title: Bridget Jones: The Edge of Reason
programme.desc: The disaster-prone journalist seems to have finally found the perfect boyfriend. However, when the couple start to squabble over their personal habits, she decides to decamp for a while to Thailand and write a travelogue. Unfortunately, she has reckoned without the reappearance of a duplicitous old flame - and a spell behind bars in a Thai prison. Romantic comedy sequel, with Renee Zellweger, Colin Firth, Hugh Grant, Jim Broadbent and Gemma Jones.

programme.title: Snow White & the Huntsman
programme.desc: An evil queen learns that her reign will last for ever if she kills a princess, so sends a renowned warrior to find and murder her. However, he comes to realise his mistress's evil ways, and instead trains his intended victim to fight so they can bring the tyrant's rule to an end. Fantasy adventure, with Kristen Stewart, Chris Hemsworth and Charlize Theron.

programme.title: The Huntsman: Winter's War
programme.desc: Eric and fellow warrior Sara, raised as members of ice Queen Freya's army, try to conceal their forbidden love as they fight to survive the wicked intentions of both Freya and her sister Ravenna. However, as war between the siblings escalates, Eric and Sara unite with Freya in an attempt to end Ravenna's wicked reign once and for all. Fantasy adventure, starring Chris Hemsworth, Charlize Theron, Emily Blunt and Jessica Chastain.

programme.title: Hotel Transylvania
programme.desc: Dracula opens a luxury resort for monsters, to provide a refuge from terrified humans. His cosy sanctuary is disrupted when a normal man unwittingly checks in, and the situation is complicated when the unwanted guest takes a liking to the count's daughter. Animated comedy, with the voices of Adam Sandler and Andy Samberg.

programme.title: Hotel Transylvania 2
programme.desc: Dracula is worried that his half-human grandson is not showing any vampiric tendencies, so enlists the help of his fellow monsters in showing the youngster how it is done. The count is shocked to receive an unwelcome visit from his own father, who does not approve of his son's tolerance of humans. Animated comedy, with the voices of Adam Sandler and Andy Samberg.

programme.title: Hotel Transylvania 3: A Monster Vacation
programme.desc: Count Dracula and company participate in a cruise for sea-loving monsters, unaware that their boat is being commandeered by the monster-hating Van Helsing family. Animated sequel, featuring the voices of Adam Sandler, Andy Samberg and Selena Gomez.

programme.title: Rise of the Guardians
programme.desc: Magical beings from folklore, including Santa Claus, Jack Frost and the Easter Bunny, join forces to defeat the plans of an evil spirit, who intends to steal the dreams of children and use the power they grant him to dominate the world. Animated adventure, with the voices of Chris Pine, Alec Baldwin, Hugh Jackman, Isla Fisher and Jude Law.

programme.title: Horrible Bosses
programme.desc: A power-crazed bully, a sleazy cocaine addict and a sexual predator each make an employee's life a misery, but the three workers cannot afford to quit their jobs. They resort to desperate measures by conspiring to murder each other's bosses, with a little help from an eccentric ex-convict. Comedy, starring Jason Bateman, Charlie Day, Jason Sudeikis, Kevin Spacey, Jennifer Aniston and Colin Farrell.

programme.title: Pitch Perfect
programme.desc: Under heavy pressure from her father, Beca reluctantly starts her first year at Barden University and gets an internship at the school radio station. She soon acquires a new circle of friends in the form of a band of misfits with a shared talent for singing, joining their a cappella group and trying to inject some much needed energy into their repertoire. Comedy, starring Anna Kendrick, Brittany Snow, Anna Camp, Rebel Wilson and Skylar Astin.

programme.title: Pitch Perfect 2
programme.desc: A Cappella group the Barden Bellas enjoy an unprecedented run of success, until a disastrous performance sees them banned from national competitions and beset by scandal. They attempt to turn their fortunes around and redeem their reputation by competing in the World Championships of A Cappella in Copenhagen. Comedy sequel, starring Anna Kendrick and Rebel Wilson.

programme.title: Pitch Perfect 3
programme.desc: Following their win at the world championship, the now-separated Bellas (an all-female a cappella singing group) reunite for one last singing competition at an overseas USO tour. However, they face a squad who uses both instruments and voices. Final part of the blockbusting comedy trilogy, starring Anna Kendrick, Rebel Wilson and Brittany Snow.

programme.title: Congo
programme.desc: An expedition to find King Solomon's diamond mines in the jungles of the Congo disappears without trace. The tycoon behind the mission sends his assistant, a former CIA agent, to find out what became of the explorers - only to discover that the party met a grisly fate at the hands of a horde of vicious apes. Action adventure based on Michael Crichton's novel, with Dylan Walsh, Laura Linney, Tim Curry and Grant Heslov.

programme.title: Parenthood
programme.desc: Anxious family man Gil Buckman is determined to have a better relationship with his three children than he had with his tough father. Elsewhere, his two sisters are also having family problems - one is struggling to understand her two troubled teenagers, while the other's husband wants to turn their toddler into a child genius. Comedy drama, starring Steve Martin, Keanu Reeves, Mary Steenburgen, Jason Robards and Dianne Wiest.

programme.title: Sky Cinema Preview-Oct 2025
programme.desc: Previews of the films now playing on Sky Cinema plus other highlights showing on Sky.

programme.title: My Big Fat Greek Wedding 2
programme.desc: A woman struggling to cope with a rebellious daughter and a marriage that has strayed into a rocky patch discovers a shocking family secret - her parents' marriage is not legal. She decides to try and resolve the situation by getting the family to rally round and organise the most elaborate wedding imaginable. Romantic comedy sequel, starring Nia Vardalos and John Corbett.

programme.title: Crazy Rich Asians
programme.desc: When New York University professor Rachel Chu heads to Singapore with her boyfriend, Nick Young, she's surprised to learn he's from an extremely wealthy family. The problem is they aren't so approving of her, so she attempts to win them over. Blockbusting comedy based on Kevin Kwan's novel, starring Constance Wu, Henry Golding, Gemma Chan and Michelle Yeoh.

programme.title: Junior
programme.desc: A fertility expert pioneers a treatment enabling men to become pregnant and carry babies to full term. When the authorities cancel funding for the research, he decides to test it on himself, but gives little thought to how difficult it will be to keep it a secret. The situation is further complicated when he starts to fall for the woman whose child he is carrying. Comedy, with Arnold Schwarzenegger, Danny DeVito, Emma Thompson and Frank Langella.

programme.title: The Holdovers
programme.desc: Barton Academy boarding school teacher Paul Hunham incurs the wrath of headmaster Dr Hardy Woodrup by failing the son of a powerful senator. As punishment, Woodrup selects Paul to remain on campus over Christmas to chaperone the boys who won't be travelling home for the holidays. Alexander Payne's comedy drama, starring Paul Giamatti, Da'Vine Joy Randolph and Dominic Sessa.

programme.title: The Nutty Professor
programme.desc: An obese, terminally shy professor invents a potion that transforms him into a slim, loud-mouthed charmer. His new streamlined self immediately sets out to woo the woman of his dreams - but soon starts to ride roughshod over everything he used to care about. Remake of the 1963 Jerry Lewis comedy, starring Eddie Murphy, Jada Pinkett Smith, James Coburn and Larry Miller.

programme.title: Nutty Professor II: The Klumps
programme.desc: Bumbling scientist Sherman Klump is engaged to be married and determined to rid himself of his troublesome alter ego Buddy Love for ever. All his problems look set to be solved by his fiancee's latest DNA experiment - but things are about to spiral out of control. Comedy sequel, starring Eddie Murphy in multiple roles, along with Janet Jackson and Larry Miller.

programme.title: Baywatch
programme.desc: A veteran lifeguard commands a highly trained team that keeps the sun-kissed resort of Emerald Bay safe. As he breaks in some new recruits - including an insubordinate former Olympic swimmer - he has to contend with a dangerous new drug sweeping the beach. Action comedy based on the TV series, starring Dwayne Johnson, Zac Efron, Alexandra Daddario and Priyanka Chopra.

programme.title: Love Actually
programme.desc: Ten interlinked stories of people searching for and finding love. While the newly elected, bachelor British prime minister is smitten by a junior staff member at 10 Downing Street, a heartbroken writer heads for France to get over a failed relationship, and a faded rock star aims to reinvent himself in time for Christmas. Richard Curtis's romantic comedy, with Hugh Grant, Martine McCutcheon, Emma Thompson, Alan Rickman, Colin Firth, Bill Nighy and Liam Neeson.

programme.title: The Holiday
programme.desc: Two single women living on opposite sides of the Atlantic agree to exchange houses over the Christmas holidays. In their new surroundings, both women unexpectedly encounter prospective partners, but as the house swap draws to a close, difficult decisions have to be made about their blossoming relationships. Romantic comedy, starring Cameron Diaz, Kate Winslet, Jack Black, Jude Law and Eli Wallach.

programme.title: Hollow Man
programme.desc: A brilliant scientist tests an invisibility serum on himself, but becomes dangerously intoxicated by the power he acquires. He abandons his morals and heads out into the city to take full advantage of his condition. Realising he has been up to no good, concerned colleagues decide to confront him - with terrible consequences. Paul Verhoeven's sci-fi thriller, starring Kevin Bacon, Elisabeth Shue, Josh Brolin and Kim Dickens.

programme.title: Ghost Rider
programme.desc: Motorcycle stuntman Johnny Blaze sells his soul to diabolical Mephistopheles to save the life of his father. His bargain dooms him to pass each night as Ghost Rider, a demonic skeletal biker bound to take evil souls to Hell. However, conflict between Mephistopheles and his son offers Johnny the chance to win back his humanity. Fantasy thriller based on the comic-book, starring Nicolas Cage, Eva Mendes and Wes Bentley.

programme.title: Total Recall
programme.desc: A man living in a bleak future years after a nuclear war has fake memories of being a secret agent implanted into his brain. However, the procedure uncovers the fact that he really is a spy with his memory erased, and he is forced to become a fugitive from the totalitarian government. Sci-fi thriller remake, with Colin Farrell, Kate Beckinsale and Jessica Biel.

programme.title: Snow White & the Huntsman
programme.desc: An evil queen learns that her reign will last for ever if she kills a princess, so sends a renowned warrior to find and murder her. However, he comes to realise his mistress's evil ways, and instead trains his intended victim to fight so they can bring the tyrant's rule to an end. Fantasy adventure, with Kristen Stewart, Chris Hemsworth and Charlize Theron.

programme.title: The Huntsman: Winter's War
programme.desc: Eric and fellow warrior Sara, raised as members of ice Queen Freya's army, try to conceal their forbidden love as they fight to survive the wicked intentions of both Freya and her sister Ravenna. However, as war between the siblings escalates, Eric and Sara unite with Freya in an attempt to end Ravenna's wicked reign once and for all. Fantasy adventure, starring Chris Hemsworth, Charlize Theron, Emily Blunt and Jessica Chastain.

programme.title: Jack Reacher
programme.desc: A former army sniper is arrested following a random shooting that leaves five people dead, but protests his innocence. An elusive former military police investigator is called in to examine the case, and becomes convinced a conspiracy is at work. Action thriller based on Lee Child's novel One Shot, starring Tom Cruise, Rosamund Pike, Werner Herzog and Robert Duvall.

programme.title: Jack Reacher: Never Go Back
programme.desc: The nomadic vigilante tries to save an army major who has been framed for murder and treason. Jack Reacher discovers that Turner has been targeted by a secret government conspiracy, and together they go on the run to expose the truth. Director Edward Zwick's blockbusting action thriller sequel based on Lee Child's novel, starring Tom Cruise, Cobie Smulders, Danika Yarosh and Aldis Hodge.

programme.title: Aquaman and the Lost Kingdom
programme.desc: The underwater kingdom of Atlantis's fate hangs in the balance when ruthless mercenary David Kane, aka Black Manta, attempts to avenge his father's death at the hands of Aquaman by wielding a mythical trident. Fantasy adventure, starring Jason Momoa, Yahya Abdul-Mateen II, Patrick Wilson, Dolph Lundgren, Nicole Kidman and Amber Heard.

programme.title: The Da Vinci Code
programme.desc: A respected academic goes on the run when he is framed for the murder of a French historian. Pursued by the detective on the case and a sinister assassin monk, he strives to unmask the culprit, leading to a conspiracy determined to preserve a 2,000-year-old secret at any cost. Thriller based on Dan Brown's novel, starring Tom Hanks, Audrey Tautou, Ian McKellen, Paul Bettany and Jean Reno.

programme.title: There Will Be Blood
programme.desc: An oil prospector presents the public image of a caring family man while nurturing a murderous ambition to seize control of land and wealth at any cost. But his insatiable greed leads to a violent conflict with a young priest who is also intent on using the people and resources of an oil-rich town for his own ends. Paul Thomas Anderson's historical drama, starring an Oscar-winning Daniel Day-Lewis, with Paul Dano and Dillon Freasier.

programme.title: Law Abiding Citizen
programme.desc: A man is forced to witness the murder of his wife and daughter, and is driven to despair when one of the perpetrators walks free at trial. Years later, he begins a campaign of vigilante violence, seeking revenge on the killers and the justice system that failed to punish them, particularly an assistant district attorney who allowed the defendant to make a deal during the court proceedings. Thriller, with Gerard Butler and Jamie Foxx.

programme.title: The Punisher
programme.desc: FBI agent Frank Castle enrages a powerful gangland kingpin when a gunfight accidentally causes the death of the mobster's son. The crime boss retaliates by wiping out Castle's entire family, but the lawman reinvents himself as a vigilante, acting as judge, jury and executioner to the underworld. Thriller based on the Marvel comic-book anti-hero, starring Thomas Jane, John Travolta, Will Patton, Rebecca Romijn and Roy Scheider.

programme.title: Last Week Tonight With John Oliver
